title: The vet, 2022
logline: The vet's building from the lot, the same one from 1999: the pup, seven, on the step with his leash looped on the rail, waiting to be taken in. The man not drawn. The three legs the building knows.

panels.composition: A small veterinary clinic from its lot: a small three-legged dog sitting on the front step with its leash looped over the rail, the door shut, nobody else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small veterinary clinic seen from its lot with a small three-legged dog sitting on the front step and its leash looped over the rail, the door shut, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
